ticket.transcript_native: 客人說主臥室冷氣在滴水，地板已經濕了一塊，問我們要怎麼處理。今天下午有新客人三點要入住，趕快。
ticket.transcript_en: The guest says the master-bedroom AC is leaking water, the floor is already wet in one spot, and they're asking how we'll handle it. New guest checks in at 3pm today — please hurry.

dispatch_draft.notes_for_vendor_zh: Warm Taipei 2BR 主臥冷氣漏水，下午 3pm 有新客入住，請優先處理。鑰匙密碼：詳問 Shirley。
dispatch_draft.notes_for_guest_zh: 已派維修師傅 90 分鐘內到場，請暫關冷氣並使用客廳分離式機。我們會補償您今晚一杯飲品。

brain_sources.title: Ben — 2026-02-14 voice memo on Taipei vendor preference
brain_sources.snippet: For Taipei, default to Lin HVAC. They're 30% more expensive than the cheap option but they show up the same day, and same-day matters more than price when there's a check-in.

brain_sources.title: Property record — Warm Taipei 2BR
brain_sources.snippet: AC units: master 12000 BTU split (Hitachi, installed 2024-08), living 18000 BTU split (Daikin, installed 2024-08). Master AC has prior leak history (2025-09) — drain line clog suspected.

brain_sources.title: SOP — HVAC leak with imminent check-in
brain_sources.snippet: 1) Notify guest within 5min. 2) Dispatch vendor with cost cap. 3) Confirm vendor ETA before guest is told. 4) If ETA > urgency window, escalate to operator with relocation budget. 5) Always offer compensatory gesture (drink, late checkout).

brain_sources.title: Resolved 2025-09-12 — same unit, same issue
brain_sources.snippet: Lin HVAC dispatched, cleared drain line, total $128. Resolved before 4pm check-in. Guest gifted $20 drink credit. No further leaks until now.

resolution.guest_response: Acknowledged, AC off, will use living room unit until vendor arrives.

skill_artifact.name: handle_hvac_leak
skill_artifact.description: Triage and dispatch for HVAC leaks at managed properties. Optimized for imminent-checkin scenarios.

proposed_rule.title: Auto-flag high-severity HVAC at properties with imminent check-in
proposed_rule.description: When category=hvac_leak AND severity>=4 AND time_to_next_checkin_h <= 6 at any managed property, auto-dispatch preferred same-day vendor and notify operator on Slack before authorization above $200.
proposed_rule.rationale: This pattern resolved 2/2 prior tickets within budget and SLA. Codifying it removes the dispatch-decision latency.
proposed_rule.lightsprint_prompt: Add a comp_rule.py automation: when an hvac_leak ticket at any managed property has severity >= 4 AND time_to_next_checkin_h <= 6, auto-dispatch preferred same-day vendor and post a Slack notification to Ben if cost_estimate exceeds $200. Tag the LLM call with metadata.property_id, metadata.ticket_id, and metadata.tier='strong' so it shows up in the TokenRouter cost ticker correctly.
